scripts.deploy: npm run build && bash scripts/guard-wrangler-deploy.sh env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN deno run -A npm:wrangler@4.90.0 pages deploy dist --project-name fenrir-bridge --branch main
scripts.deploy:workers: bash scripts/guard-wrangler-deploy.sh env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN deno run -A npm:wrangler@4.90.0 deploy --config wrangler.fenrir-mcp-beta.toml && bash scripts/guard-wrangler-deploy.sh env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN deno run -A npm:wrangler@4.90.0 deploy --config wrangler.fenrir-gate-router.toml && bash scripts/guard-wrangler-deploy.sh env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN deno run -A npm:wrangler@4.90.0 deploy --config wrangler.fenrir-stars.toml
scripts.deploy:ci: npm run build && bash scripts/guard-wrangler-deploy.sh deno run -A npm:wrangler@4.90.0 pages deploy dist --project-name fenrir-bridge --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.cloudflare:whoami: env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false deno run -A npm:wrangler@4.90.0 whoami
scripts.mcp:beta:dev: env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN deno run -A npm:wrangler@4.90.0 dev --config wrangler.fenrir-mcp-beta.toml --local
scripts.mcp:beta:deploy: env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN deno run -A npm:wrangler@4.90.0 deploy --config wrangler.fenrir-mcp-beta.toml
